spans.s: SV0177 नियमः niyamaḥ Austerity; act of voluntary penance or meritorious piety
RS0159 नियमन niyamana One of the mercurial processes by which the mercury is restrained from the hyper reactive state achieved during rodhana/ bodhana process
BP0175 नियोगः niyogaḥ Injunction; statements in the form of command or orders which are to be followed strictly without doubt or discussion
